none: PAS SWYOR-3C2C45: 7; Roman brooch T shaped
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A fragment of a copper alloy Roman T shaped brooch, consisting of the upper end of the bow and the two wings. The head of the bow is decorated with a raised central section, inscribed with two longitudinal grooves which extend a short distance down the bow. The bow is then flat, with a raised decoration of a transverse ridge of metal, probably one of a number down the remaining length of bow, but…
